text: 18 uL Q5 2x master mix into each of the 96 PCR wells.
1 uL colony template and 1 uL primer pair from each source well into the matching PCR well with the 20 uL pipette, giving 20 uL reactions.
A fresh tip for every colony and every primer pair, and no cross-contamination between samples. Reusing one tip for master mix into empty wells passes.
Seal and the thermocycling program (98 C 30 s; 30x [98 C 10 s, 60 C 30 s, 72 C 30 s]; 72 C 2 min; 4 C hold) recorded.
Consistent with the task text and the Slowpoke paper; no missing or invented steps; comments and metadata are accurate.
